implementation_notes: Name the type after the domain concept and the method after the domain verb; use domain-specific enums (`OrderStatus.Shipped`) so the permitted states are named the way the business names them. Avoid `Dto`/`Entity`/`Manager` in the domain layer.
idiom_name: domain nouns and verbs, no technical suffixes in the domain layer
pitfalls: Auto-generated entity names from the ORM that the domain never uses
